status: follow-up specified after inspection of original null/trade-off results
cost_definition: mean of per-agent wall/blocked-conflict/quota indicators plus allocated aggregate excess; expected empirical per-step rate, not hard safety
regularization: state-wise centered-map Frobenius trace normalization; fixed orthogonal zero-sum action rotation preserves singular values for nonsemantic control
checkpoint_rule: final budgeted checkpoint; no best-test-checkpoint selection
uncertainty: paired training-seed percentile bootstrap; 5000 resamples; pointwise exploratory intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim
rware_configuration: native tiny and small 4-agent easy-request settings; unchanged native dynamics; public task/map features, explicit common reward shaping, and added entry/quota institutions
external_claim: independent warehouse implementation, not a separate real-world domain; not standard unmodified RWARE observation/reward benchmark scores
baseline_claim: matched discrete-action empirical-rate PPO-Lagrangian adaptation; not a reproduction of MACPO or the published MAPPO-Lagrangian implementation
crypto_protocol_order: all six permutations balanced within each episode
trust_boundary: same frozen custom-warehouse circuits; trusted state/executor; no RWARE proof claim; reset continuity checked by independent host assertions
run_policy: No outcome-based early stopping, parameter search or extension. Preserve all failed attempts. Validation bugs may be corrected only before a new immutable full plan is frozen.
